department.name: Computer Science Department
department.curriculum: IB Diploma Programme Computer Science (SL & HL)

hero.title: The Unified IB Computer Science Revision & Coursework Ecosystem
hero.lead: The official academic command center for IB Diploma Programme Computer Science (SL & HL) at Emirates International School Meadows. Engineered to integrate comprehensive topic-by-topic exam revision, interactive question banks with mark scheme validation, syllabus scope-and-sequence tracking, real-time assessment milestone schedules, and a verified classroom resource repository into a single high-velocity environment.

pillars.title: Computational Thinking & Python
pillars.description: Deep algorithmic training focusing on decomposition, pattern recognition, and Big O complexity analysis using Python. Students master data structures, recursive paradigms, and object-oriented architectures.

pillars.title: Systems & Network Architecture
pillars.description: Rigorous investigation into CPU machine cycles, binary representation, packet-switched routing protocols, relational database normalization, and distributed client-server systems.

pillars.title: Real-World Client Engineering
pillars.description: The 30-mark Internal Assessment tasks students with engineering a bespoke computational software solution for an authentic problem, following professional software development lifecycles and empirical user testing.

team.name: Neha Siddiqui
team.bio: Directs the IB Diploma Computer Science program at Emirates International School Meadows. Oversees syllabus delivery across Standard and Higher Levels, Internal Assessment moderation, and examination strategy.

team.name: Anish Dongarkar
team.bio: Coordinates department web engineering, interactive question bank tooling, UI state architecture, and technical peer programming support across Python data structures, algorithms, and HL topics.

team.name: Rudolph Babaran
team.role: Lead Web Architect & AI Ethics / Machine Learning
team.bio: Lead architect and developer of the EIS Computer Science platform. Built the majority of the departmental website and interactive tools, alongside leading Theme A4 Machine Learning instruction, Case Study analysis, and AI ethics workshops.

team.name: Yahya Syed Muhammad
team.bio: Directs student support, academic advisory, and cohort onboarding, specializing in Standard Level (SL) candidates. Guides students through course navigation, IA milestone timelines, and day-to-day study workflow strategies.

components.title: Concepts of Computer Science
components.description: Assesses theoretical foundations across Theme A, combined with the pre-seen scenario stimulus.

sections.name: Section A
sections.desc: Compulsory extended-response questions on Themes A1–A4.

sections.name: Section B
sections.desc: In-depth Case Study extended-response questions on pre-seen stimulus.

components.title: Computational Thinking & Python
components.description: Assesses algorithmic decomposition, programming syntax, and data structures in Python across Theme B.

sections.name: Algorithmic Section
sections.desc: Language-agnostic logic, trace tables, and decomposition.

sections.name: Coding Section
sections.desc: OOP classes, inheritance, Big O complexity, and ADTs (HL).

components.title: The Computational Solution
components.description: Authentic software product engineered for an authentic problem, assessed across Criteria A through E.

sections.name: Criteria A–C
sections.desc: Planning, record of tasks, and algorithmic implementation.

sections.name: Criteria D–E
sections.desc: Screencast video demo, user feedback, and evaluation.

noticeBanner.title: Official Syllabus Note on Case Study Assessment
noticeBanner.text: Under the official IB DP Computer Science Subject Guide, the pre-seen annual case study is assessed strictly within Paper 1 Section B extended responses as an integrated external examination component.

logistics.title: CS Innovation Lab & Workstations

items.title: Development Environments

items.title: Hardware Kits

logistics.title: After-School Clinics & IA Mentorship
logistics.lead: Weekly peer tutoring and teacher drop-in sessions designed to provide targeted assistance on coding, algorithm design, and IA criteria milestones.

items.title: Python Help Clinic

items.title: IA Milestones Clinic
items.desc: One-on-one review of Criterion A planning through Criterion E evaluation.

items.title: Timings & Schedules
items.desc: Announced weekly via the Deadlines & Announcements board.

logistics.title: Academic Integrity & Responsible AI
logistics.lead: Adherence to the IB Academic Integrity policy is strictly upheld across all course submissions, internal assessments, and classroom projects.

items.title: Original Software
items.desc: All code written for the Internal Assessment must be authentic and properly documented.

items.title: Library Citations
items.desc: External Python libraries, APIs, and algorithms must be transparently acknowledged.

logistics.title: Speaking Inquiries & Admissions
